whyItMatters: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a setup that accepts whatever metadata variant a repository serves.
actions: Regenerate the artifact with integrity data enabled and commit the recorded digest or checksum. Specifically: fix a setup that accepts whatever metadata variant a repository serves.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm settings.gradle no longer carries a setup that accepts whatever metadata variant a repository serves.
